entities.name: Bronze Age of Comic Books
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The Bronze Age of Comic Books is an informal name for a period in the history of American superhero comic books, usually said to run from 1970 to 1985. It follows the Silver Age of Comic Books and is followed by the Modern Age of Comic Books.
